translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tegin Jesús tulemalga chogalbal: —Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi pemal-itigin-pukmalad-wal-walgwen, yo pe purkweddu, pemal Pab-neg-takmaid-kannalegedgin-nonikoed takmalo.
Jesús arpak chipú kanoni-kujad
Tegin te ibanerkwagin, Jesús yal-tummad-pirzhe, pidzhi walapá aga e-chapingan-ches; Pedro, Jacobo, Juan; tenal Jesúsgin pelugles walabake.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapingan-wagin, arpak akalgus. Tenal Jesús-e-moldin pi-pi-pip kanoni, ukur-walga pul chipú takle-pes.
Tegidgin Jesús-e-chapingan pato takalmal, Elías tegin Moisés. Jesúsbak chunmananimal.
Tegin Pedro Jesúsga chogal: —Tule-oturdaked, anmal wegin nued pukwamal. Al anmal pemalga wegin kwapá obuneg chobnemal, pega kwagwen, Moisésga kwagwen, tegin Elíasga kwagwenmo.
Imi teun takalgu, Pedro peyedzhe-kwakijadbal aga mag itojul, ede ibigin chunmanai.
Tegin po aktenonigu, Jesúsmal po-yabal pél ukposmal. Tegin po-yabal-akar tule-kakapurwa kolnoni chogal: —Imi wedin an-Machi-Pilaled. Al pemal nue an-Machi-itogenabmal.
Tegidgin po miledgu, Jesús-e-chapingan Elías-Moisés-amialmal, pato taklejulmal, Jesúsbi walkwénna pato kwichi-takalmal.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak yal-pir-akar kannan aktealmalgu, Jesús aga e-chapingan-walapágwadga chogal: —Pe melle tule-pimaladga pe pal an-chogo, pe imis imial immal takchad. Tenal an-Te-Tule-Chunna purkwijad-akar kannan tullejal, kep pe tulemalga chogo.
Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan-walpágwad ulubgin immal-takchad chabosmal. Tenal tule-walpágwad aga emal-emal ekisaldamal: —¿Ibi chog-wede, ‘An kannan tullejal, kep pe an-chogo?’
Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad chogmal: ‘Imi Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule ampayo tageddu, Elías inzhel noniko.’ ¿Ibiga teob chogmaldé?

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Teobdo. Imi Elías inzhel nonikodo, tulemal-pel-kwapa kuakwa Pabgin pinzhegal. Tegin Jesús chogalbal: —¿Tede ibiga Pab-kartagin nermakal maichun, an-Te-Tule-Chunna peyedzhe wilegenab, tegin tulemal istar an-takenabmal? Imi pemal nuekwa wegin pinzheenabmal.
Tenal an pemalga chogzhundo: tule-Elíasyobid pato arpigus, tenal tulemal a-itoleged sapejul we tule-imasmal, akpene Pab-kartagin choglejadyob.
Jesús tule-machigin-nia-maid-onojad

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapingan-walapágwadbak nonigu, taknoni, e-chapingan-pimalad pukwamal. Tenal Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad Jesús-e-chapingan-pukmaladbak a-imananimal, tegin tule-pimalad íchejul tar-takpukmalmo.
Tegin tule-takpukmalad Jesús-takchagu, weob pakal pesmal. Tegin tulemal Jesús-abin abarmadmal, Jesúsga choggalmal, pe tani-jogeye.
Tegin Jesús tulemalzhe ekichial: —¿Ibiga pemalde Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamaladbak aga imananimal-wede?
Tegin tule-takpukmalad-walgwen Jesúsga chogal: —Tule-oturdaked, antin pega machi-cheinoni. Tenal an-machigin nia-maidbal an-machi keg chunma.

Tenal an-machi meke-pia nadel, nia an-machi-okoele. Al nia machigin tognonikil, machi-olenonida, tegin machi kaka-maku-makaldabal. Tegin machi nugal kolaldabal, tegin abgan-kannalegaldabal. Tenal an pe-chapinganga chogzhan an-machigin nia-onogal. Tenal pe-chapingan keg kugusmal.

Tegin Jesús tulemalga chogal: —Imi pemal-ankin-penmalad, ¿an inkwáje pemalbak kudiguenabmal-wede ankin penzhulmalgal? ¿Tegin an inkwáje pemal-abin-purtigo-wede, pemal kep ankin ibzhemalgal? Nabir. Imisgin pe anka machi-chedagodo, an pega nudagal.

Tegin tulemal Jesúszhe machi-cheinonimalgu, nia Jesús-takchadbal, neg-owededgin pela-pela kalzhemai machi-imas. Tegin nia napkin machi-olasgu, paparmamai machi-ebes. Tegin machi kakabal maku-mimai-pesbal.
Tegin Jesús machi-e-pabzhe ekichial: —¿Inkwagus niade pe-machigin mai-wede? Tegin machi-e-pab Jesúsga chogal: —Toto-akar.
Tenal nia melugus chogin, tegin tigin machi-olegus machi-mesgal. Tenal pe wilejakwa anmal-takel, tegin pe aga unni itogel, pe anmal-wis-pentakodo.
Tegin Jesús machi-e-pabga chogal: —¿Ibiga pe weob anka chogde, an unni-dewa pe-machi-nudagal? Tenal tule-Pabgin-penzhulil, meke-ibi immal nabir we tulega kunoniko.
Tegin machi-nia-nikad-e-pab pukib-itogedgin sapejul Jesúsga chogal: —Antin pegin ibzhedo. Tenal pe an-wis-pentako, an melle pegin pengugalma.

Tegin Jesús takchagu tulemal-ichejul-ampagunoni, Jesús niaga chogal: —Nia-keg-chunmaked, ua-yalli-machi-imajad, imisgin an pega chogdo: ilgwen pe we machi-akar pe nao; tegin pe we machigin melle pal tognoniko.

Tegidgin nia sapejul kolmasgu, peyedzhe neg-owededgin pela-pela kalzhemai machi-ebes. Tegin nia machigin kep noszhun. Tenal machi ilgwen purkwijadyob mellemai-pes. Tegin tule-takpukmalad chogalmal: —We machidin purkwis.
Tenal Jesús chunkalbal machi-kasgu, machi-okwichis. Tegin machi Jesúsga neg wisgual. Tegin machi ilgwen Jesúsga nugunonijun.
Tegin Jesús machi-nudajad-cholbal aga e-chapinganbak neg-yabal ukposmal. Tegin e-chapingan pidzhi Jesúszhe ekichialmal: —¿Ibiga anmal keg we machigin nia-onogus-wede?

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Tenal wegiid-niamal, tutujul onogal. Tenal (pemal-mas-kunchulidginbi,) tegin Pab-Tummadzhe-koledginbi, pemal kep unnigumalo wegiid-niamal-onogal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak machi-nudajad-akar nadmalzhun.
Jesús ilbogus aga chogzhagujad ede purkweenab
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak nadgu, ampa Galileabal kudii-pesmal. Imi teun Jesús Pab-igalgin aga e-chapingan-oturdanai. Al Jesús peichul tule-pimalad e-wisgu, ede pia kudii.
Tenal teun Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —An-Te-Tule-Chunna tule-anpak-aichulmaladzhe uklego, tegin we tulemal an-mejo, tegin an ibapágin kannan tullebalo.
Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan ampa aku-itomal, Jesús ega igi chogzhad. Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan tob Jesúszhe ekismalgus ibi chogle-wede.
Jesús chogzhagujad: “Pe tule-tummadga kubiel, pe tule-totogwadyob naneenab”
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak Capernaum-neg-kweburzhe nonigu, neggin togzhamal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganzhe ekichial: —¿Pemalde, igalbal ibigin aga imadanimal-wede?
Tenal Jesús-e-chapingan ilgwen yakír pesmal. Imi teun e-chapingan igalbal-imakalmaladdin aga chogalmal: “¿Toa anmal-abalgin, pul tule-tummadga kuo?” Al Jesús-e-chapingan ilgwen yakir pesmal.

Tegin Jesús chigwisgu, e-chapingan-walambe-kakabogwadga chogal: —Pemal wis ampagumalgwelo an-itogal. Imi meke-ibi-tule pul-tule-tummadga togbi-kujiil, pul tule-totogwadyob naneenab; tule-pimaladga pél immal imagal.
Tegin Jesús e-chapingan-wagin nuchu-chusgu, nukalgin nuchu-chis. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal:
—Imi meke-ibi-tule an-nuggin nuchu-walgwen-abingajal, we tule an-abingasmo, tenal anpi an-abingaszhul, tenal tule-an-palmialid-abingasmo.

Tegin Juan Jesúsga chogal: —Tule-oturdaked, anmal tule-walgwen-takcha, pe-nuggin tulemalgin niamal-onodii. Tenal we tule anmal-pakamaladzhulidbal anmal we tulegin igal-kasmal melle pe-nuggin nia-onogal.
Tegin Jesús Juanga chogal: “Pe melle tulegin igal-pal-kao an-nuggin nia-onogal. Imi tule an-nuggin nabir immal-taktijulid imakel, untarzhal-nao, ankin istar kwen chunmakojul.
Imi tule anmalbak istar chulil, we tule anmalzhikidmogad.
“Imi an chunchunnad pega chogdo: imi meke-ibi-tule pe-anpal-naidbal, pega an-nuggin ibimala-imakel, o pega ti-wis-uk-dewa, Pab Tummad keg-chulgu we tulega immal-nuegan ukmogo.”
Jesús chogzhagujad: “Pe melle iskuedgin tule-pid-egwano”
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Imi meke-ibi-tule iskuedgin ankin-ibzheed-mimmi-egwachal, we tule peyedzhe oturdalego. Tenal we tulega pul iwen-akalzhul termal-wiladgin tukalgin-akwa-mu-edinal-nai metel.
“Imi pe-chunkal iskuedgin pe-egwachal, we chunkal pul pe chiko. Imi pega pul iwen-akalzhul, chunkal-orol Pab-negzhe toggal, pe pul chunkal-pog-pel cho-chagla-keg-akinnedzhe melledgal. (
Imi cho-chagla-neggin nusmal keg pel purkwe, tegin cho-chagla keg pel akinbal.)
“Tenal pe-nag iskuedgin pe-egwachal, we nag pul pe chiko. Imi pega pul iwen-akalzhul, nag-orol Pab-negzhe toggal, pe pul nag-pog-pel cho-chagla-keg-akinnedzhe melledgal. (
Imi cho-chagla-neggin nusmal keg pel purkwe, tegin cho-chagla keg pel akinbal.)
“Tenal pe-imia iskuedgin pe-egwachal, we imia pul pe unko. Imi pega pul iwen-akalzhul, imia-kwagwen Pab-negzhe toggal, pe pul imia-pog-pel cho-chagla-keg-akinnedzhe melledgal.
Imi cho-chagla-neggin nusmal keg pel purkwe, tegin cho-chagla keg pel akinbal.
Tenal anmalgin pel-kwapa palu imalego, chogin wilub-taklegal.
“Tenal palu, ib-nueddo yer-kulle mas imagal. Tenal palu iskunonikil, keg kannan pal nudale. Tenal pemal palu-nuedyob pe nanemalo, tenal aga muchub-muchub akalzhul ampagumalo.”
